sender.zh: 臉書、Threads、IG上說要免費送手機、媽祖結緣品、寵物或嬰兒用品的網友
sender.en: Someone on Facebook, Threads or Instagram offering a free phone, temple blessing gift, pet or baby items

name.zh: 免費贈送：要你付小額運費，傳來假賣貨便網站
name.en: Free giveaway: pay a small shipping fee on a fake store-pickup site

how.zh: 詐騙者在社群平台貼文說要免費送iPhone、筆電、媽祖壓轎金或結緣品、和尚鸚鵡等，有時還附身分證照片表示不是詐騙，要你加LINE聯繫。接著說只要付幾十元運費，傳來偽冒的7-11賣貨便或全家好賣+網址。你填資料後，網頁跳出「交易異常」、「未完成金流簽署」或「需實名認證」，引導你加假客服LINE，再指示你開啟無卡提款、網銀轉帳或翻拍付款碼。原本的網友還會哭訴帳戶被凍結、小孩要開刀，用情緒勒索讓你照做。
how.en: A post on social media offers a free iPhone, laptop, Mazu temple blessing money or gifts, or pet parrots, sometimes with an ID card photo to “prove” it's not a scam, and asks you to add them on LINE. They say you only need to pay a few dozen dollars' shipping and send a fake 7-ELEVEN myship or FamilyMart link. After you fill it in, the page shows “transaction error”, “payment agreement not signed” or “real-name verification needed” and sends you to a fake LINE agent, who has you turn on cardless withdrawal, transfer by online banking or photograph your payment code. The original poster may cry that their account is frozen or a child needs surgery, to guilt you into it.

text.zh: 在社群看到免費贈送貼文，被要求加LINE。
text.en: You see a free giveaway post and are asked to add a LINE account.

text.zh: 對方說只要付小額運費，傳來假的超商寄貨網址。
text.en: They say you just pay a small shipping fee and send a fake convenience-store shipping link.

text.zh: 網頁說交易異常、要實名認證，引導你加假客服。
text.en: The page says there is an error or you must verify, and sends you to a fake agent.

text.zh: 假客服要你操作網銀、無卡提款或傳付款碼。
text.en: The fake agent has you use online banking, cardless withdrawal or send a payment code.

text.zh: 因為搬家養不了了，想把兩隻鸚鵡免費送給有愛心的人，只要出運費就好，有興趣請加LINE，先傳訊息喔：[連結]
text.en: I'm moving and can't keep them, so I want to give two parrots free to a kind home, just pay shipping. If interested add my LINE and message first: [link]

text.zh: 確定要的話我用賣貨便寄出，運費38元自付，貨到付款，下單連結在這裡：[連結]
text.en: If you're sure you want it I'll send it by myship. Shipping is 38 dollars, paid by you, cash on delivery. Order link here: [link]

zh: 臉書上說免費送手機只要付運費
送媽祖結緣品的網友傳賣貨便連結給我
填完資料說交易異常要聯絡客服
免費領養寵物要我付運費加LINE
客服說要開通金流服務才能寄出
送東西的人說他的帳戶被凍結很著急
en: someone on facebook offered a free phone if i paid shipping
a person giving away mazu blessing gifts sent me a myship link
after filling in my details it said there was an error and to contact service
a free pet adoption asked me to pay shipping and add line
customer service said i had to activate payment service before it could ship
the person giving things away said their account was frozen and was panicking

zh: 陌生人免費送高價物品，只收小額運費
傳來的賣貨便網址不是官方網址
要求實名認證、簽署金流或驗證帳戶
對方用小孩生病、被家暴等理由催你
en: A stranger gives away something valuable for just a small shipping fee.
The myship link is not the official address.
You are asked to verify your identity, sign a payment agreement or verify your account.
They pressure you with a sick child or domestic violence story.

zh: 不要點陌生網址，二次查證交易平台網站
真客服不會加LINE，更不會開視訊
不傳帳戶資料，也不翻拍付款碼
已經操作或匯款請立即打165或報警
en: Don't open unknown links; double-check the platform's real website.
Real customer service never adds you on LINE or video-calls.
Don't send account details or photos of payment codes.
If you already did something or paid, call 165 or the police at once.
